artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body. The individual is facing slightly to the right of the frame but looking towards the viewer. They have a serene expression with prominent eyes and a gentle smile. The person's hair is covered by a traditional headpiece. The attire is formal, with a dark garment under a white collar. Surrounding the figure is an octagonal frame with inscriptions, and the background has intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria

artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and stippling on laid paper

She is wearing an elegant garment consisting of a lace collar and a richly textured bodice. Around her neck, there is a distinct necklace. The border of the portrait contains text, implying a frame-like design, while the background behind the woman is a shaded texture.

The background consists of an intricately designed frame resembling a stone pattern, with inscriptions around the hexagonal border surrounding the portrait.

The man wears a cap fitting snugly on his head, partially covering his hair, with curls visible around his ear. He is dressed in a robe resembling clergy attire, likely made of heavy fabric with button detailing. The background has a lined texture, and the portrait is framed by a decorative octagonal border with inscriptions. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The style is similar to an etching, with detailed lines and shading.

He is wearing a clerical garment with a prominent, stiff collar and a cross hanging from his neck.
